About this piece

Two kinds of misfits that had never before been combined 😉

Honestly, the most interesting thing I’ve learned throughout this process is how to push my creativity in the craft of photomanipulation. Rather than just erasing a dog and sticking a wacky waving inflatable arm-flailing tube-man in a box, I can push the boundaries by combining layers of visual interest that create something truly unique and memorable. (I hope.)
